phrases.not_understood: Sorry, I did not understand. Say help for options.
phrases.help: You can say: where is the door. Guide me to the table. What is around me. How far. Who is this. Register face. What note is this. Speak in Malayalam. Speak less. Repeat. Stop. Or shut down.
phrases.nothing_to_repeat: I have not said anything yet.
phrases.which_object: Which object should I look for?
phrases.not_trained: I have not been trained to recognise {word}.
phrases.see_nothing: I do not see any objects I know.
phrases.way_blocked: The way straight ahead is blocked.
phrases.no_way: I cannot find a clear way to the {label}.
phrases.reached_dir: You have reached the {label}. It is {direction}.
phrases.lost: I lost sight of the {label}. Guidance stopped.
phrases.measure_fail: I cannot measure the distance right now.
phrases.nearest: The nearest object straight ahead is {distance} away.
phrases.face_unknown: There is a person I do not know. Say register face to remember them.
